sentences.en: The driver was thrown from his seat head over heels.
sentences.zh: 1. 司机被甩得头朝下从座位上摔了下来。

sentences.en: The first baseman is the Achilles heel of our team.
sentences.zh: 2. 一垒手是我们球队的阿喀琉斯之踵（即：我们队伍中最薄弱的一环）。

sentences.en: I cooled my heels for one hour outside his office.
sentences.zh: 3. 我在他办公室外面等了一个小时。
